qualification.education_qualification: Master's degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade), Ph.D in concerned & allied relevant discipline(s), Professor/Associate Professor with 15 years' teaching/research experience, minimum 40% API score, minimum 10 research publications in peer reviewed UGC listed journals and research score of 110
qualification.details: Qualification: A master's degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in point scale wherever grading system is followed from a recognized university; A Ph. D degree in concerned & allied relevant discipline(s) in the institutions concerned with equivalent published works; A minimum of 40% score as stipulated in the Academic Performance Indicator (API) based performance appraisal in Appendix-III for direct requirement of Principals in colleges as per Govt. of Assam Guidelines; A minimum of 10 research publications in peer reviewed of UGC listed journals and minimum of 110 research score as per Appendix-II at Table 2 Experience: Professor/ Associate Professor with a total experience of fifteen years of teaching /research in college or University and other institution of Higher Education Age limit: Maximum 55 years | Other conditions: | Applicants should have the required qualifications and experience as per latest UGC regulations and Govt. of Assam guidelines Working Principals need apply through proper channel

how_to_apply: Apply in the prescribed proforma issued by the DHE Assam.
Attach complete Bio-Data and all testimonials from HSLC onwards.
Attach a non-refundable demand draft of Rs. 5000/- drawn in favour of Swahid Smriti Mahavidyalaya, Belsor, Nalbari, Assam 781304, A/C no 2219186573, IFSC CBIN0281582, payable at CBI, Belsor Branch.
Submit to the President, Governing Body, Swahid Smriti Mahavidyalaya, Belsor, Nalbari, Assam, 781304 within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.
Working Principals must apply through proper channel.
Make sure it reaches by 3 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: A master's degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in point scale wherever grading system is followed from a recognized university; A Ph. D degree in concerned & allied relevant discipline(s) in the institutions concerned with equivalent published works; A minimum of 40% score as stipulated in the Academic Performance Indicator (API) based performance appraisal in Appendix-III for direct requirement of Principals in colleges as per Govt. of Assam Guidelines; A minimum of 10 research publications in peer reviewed of UGC listed journals and minimum of 110 research score as per Appendix-II at Table 2 Experience: Professor/ Associate Professor with a total experience of fifteen years of teaching /research in college or University and other institution of Higher Education Age limit: Maximum 55 years Other conditions: Applicants should have the required qualifications and experience as per latest UGC regulations and Govt. of Assam guidelines Working Principals need apply through proper channel

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SSM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for SSM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed proforma issued by the DHE Assam) and send it to President, Governing Body, Swahid Smriti Mahavidyalaya, Belsor, Nalbari, Assam, 781304, by post, to reach by 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for SSM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All candidates: Rs. 5000 (five thousand only) by demand draft (non-refundable).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 55 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Not mentioned.

faq.answer: Master's degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade), Ph.D in concerned & allied relevant discipline(s), Professor/Associate Professor with 15 years' teaching/research experience, minimum 40% API score, minimum 10 research publications in peer reviewed UGC listed journals and research score of 110.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants should have the required qualifications and experience as per latest UGC regulations and Govt. of Assam guidelines. Working Principals need apply through proper channel.
